observation.command: curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -2; grep -c '<title>' /workspace/out/index.html; kill 845 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "after kill: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null || echo "server stopped"
